title_sq: SHITET SUPER VILE TEK REZIDENCA LAKE DIAMOND VILLAS&RESIDENCES ,LIQENI I THATE!
description_sq:

Vila ka nje siperfaqe ndertimi prej 236 m2 neto ,oborr 220 m2 e eshte organizuar ne 3 kate:
Kati nentoke ka ndricim natyral e ofron mundesine e organizimit te nje zone relax-i ,palester,kinema,lavanderi etj!

Mundësi shumë e mirë banimi/ investimi në një nga zonat më të lakmuara për banim falë afërsisë me Parkun e Liqenit Artificial.
Disponibilitet për një post parkimi me vlerë shtesë.
title_en: SUPER VILLA FOR SALE AT LAKE DIAMOND VILLAS & RESIDENCES, DRY LAKE!
description_en: 3-story super villa for sale near the Lake Diamond Residence, the newest luxury project located near the Dry Lake area! The villa has a construction area of ​​236 m2 net, a yard of 220 m2 and is organized in 3 floors: The ground floor has natural lighting and offers the possibility of organizing a relax area, gym, cinema, laundry, etc.! The first floor is organized into a living room, separate kitchen and 1 bathroom! The second floor is organized in 3 bedrooms, 1 wardrobe, 2 bathrooms! It has 2 parking spaces! Currently, the villa is in the phase of electrical installations! The terrace of the villa is designed to be fully usable and offers a fantastic view! Comfort, privacy, outdoor activities and exclusive services are the keywords that welcome you to this complex! The residence is expected to be completed within the year 2026. Very good residential/investment opportunity in one of the most sought-after residential areas due to its proximity to the Artificial Lake Park. Availability of a parking space with additional value.
